outcome_boundary: All maximum-40-session exits must be on or before 2023-12-29
trade_model: MODEL_0 signal, next-session open, fixed signal-date 20-session-low stop, no fixed target, 40-session maximum hold
drawdown_definition: Daily mark-to-market equity versus prior high-water equity; percent drawdown divides by that high-water equity

shared_constraints.open_trade_heat: allocated initial R remains charged until exit
shared_constraints.same_day_exit_capacity: a position exiting during a session still occupies capacity for new entries that session
shared_constraints.ranking: entry date, signal date, then ticker; never future outcome
shared_constraints.cash_and_notional_model: Normalized R; no cash or maximum-notional constraint
shared_constraints.missing_mark_policy: last known close at or before the session; never use a future price

shortlist_rule: Maximum daily mark-to-market drawdown at or below 10%, positive total return, profit factor at least 1.20, at least 150 accepted trades, and no future-informed allocation decision.
constraints: Do not alter signals or trade exits in this experiment
Do not tune thresholds after inspecting discovery outcomes
Do not evaluate the untouched 2024-2025 holdout
